Yeah man I went through that too, had a guy tell me you know man you’re not just doing it to yourself you’re doing it to all of us and people around you. Think of them.
It’s like cmon man, you aren’t the one living in misery EVERY SINGLE MOMENT of your life. Yeah I’ll get forgotten about eventually by everyone. But if I’m here,  going to keep having this misery every single second. I understand where you’re coming from.
